description: Backup report emails and missed-backup alerts for one site. Hosted site: serviceId or domain; WordPress plugin site with a Backsies licence: activationId (from oma_license_list_activations). action get (default) returns enabled, frequency, recipients (empty = the account email), alerts, lastReportAt, nextReportAt. action set changes any of: enabled (report emails on/off), frequency daily|weekly|monthly (report covers the previous full day, Monday-Sunday week or month; sent after 07:00 Finnish time), recipients (up to 3 emails; [] = account email), alerts (missed-backup alert emails on/off; Lanetti support still sees missed backups).

activationId.description: WordPress plugin site with a Backsies licence: licence activation id.

alerts.description: set: missed-backup alert emails on or off.

domain.description: Hosted site domain, e.g. example.fi, instead of serviceId.

enabled.description: set: backup report emails on or off.

frequency.description: set: report covers the previous full day, week (Mon-Sun) or month; sent after 07:00 Finnish time.

recipients.description: set: up to 3 email addresses; [] = the account email.

serviceId.description: Hosted site: OMA hosting service id. Pass this, domain or activationId.

name: oma_backsies_reports
title: Backup reports and alerts
